guards.truth_usage: Saved exp270 candidates are frozen before readout-only truth is quantized for this diagnostic.
guards.interpretation: Hard-support checks are not posterior probabilities. Dynamic support is restarted after each infeasibility only to count later independent breaks. Conditioned transition NLL uses the previous row's local position-conditioned rate distribution, propagates it through the exact one-step rate kernel, and scores the next fixed truth or global-Viterbi position shift. It is a two-step local diagnostic, not a long-history filtered rate posterior, and excludes all GR emissions.
